description: This Dart source file defines the AppRouter class, which centralizes route management for a Flutter application, handling static and dynamic named routes including parsing of route parameters and fallback for unknown routes.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Contains static method onGenerateRoute to handle route generation based on route name and arguments, supporting static and dynamic routes with parameter extraction.

classes.name: _ErrorScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays an error message when route parsing or navigation fails.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Main route generator method that returns a Route object based on RouteSettings, handling static routes, dynamic parameterized routes with ID extraction, and fallback to home.

methods.name: _tryMatchWithId
methods.description: Utility method that matches a path against a base string to extract an ID segment, handling both path-like and literal template forms.

methods.name: _extractId
methods.description: Utility method that attempts to parse an ID from either the path tail or the route arguments (int or String).

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Creates a route to _ErrorScreen with the specified message when route handling fails.
